title: A Regiment for the Typewriter
author: Theo Hartwell
blurb: Petra Marchetti, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
